content:
jo_cs: Quick sync: Calypso preview kickoff in 5 days. Need final enroll list + 1-line use case + top risk for each account by Wed EOD. Sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheets/calypso-enroll (don't change headers).

sam_csm: Uploading my cohort now. Two customers require VPC/private deployment and one wants stricter data retention (30d).

ivan_eng: Re: retention - we can set retention TTL per workspace but need to know which logs/traces they want retained. Also for private deployments we need lead time (2-3 weeks) for infra.

lee_enable: I'll run a 20-min admin walkthrough during kickoff for SSO and retention settings. Can someone collect IdP metadata + retention choice?

jo_cs: Sam to capture IdP + retention in the sheet. Also add a column "renewal_risk" and mark any procurement delays.

ops_ana: Heads-up: if we enable token-level debug traces for the cohort it'll increase billing. Recommend limiting to 12h per account during first 48h. We can automate rotation and export to the analytics bucket.

sam_csm: Noted. One account asked for continuous debug for the first week. Should we allow it?

ivan_eng: Strongly prefer no continuous debug. If they need more than 24h, require approval and cost estimate. We'll offer a targeted 24h window and scheduled export.

jo_cs: Mark the continuous debug ask as "requires sign-off" and add a mitigation note. Sam, flag that customer.

lee_enable: Also request customers provide 3 canonical prompts (short/typical/edge) so we can run the eval harness. Add that to the kickoff checklist.

sam_csm: Will collect prompts. Also capturing expected RPS for those on VPC so infra can size.

ops_ana: For VPCs, we need CIDRs and expected throughput. If >100 RPS sustained, we recommend reserved capacity.

jo_cs: Good. Also add a column "ok_to_share_sanitized_notes" so we can reuse anonymized feedback later.

sam_csm: Done. One more: can enablement own the Day 7 survey and the Day 14 interview scheduling?

lee_enable: Yes. I'll draft the 3-question survey and share by Tue. I'll own interview scheduling.

ivan_eng: I'll prepare an eval runbook and a small script to export traces to s3://redwood-calypso-traces when debug windows are enabled.

reminder-bot: Reminder set: "Calypso enroll list due" on 2025-05-14 17:00 UTC.

jo_cs: Thanks all. Quick rollout checklist (short):
- Confirm enroll list (CS)
- Capture IdP + retention + RPS + prompts (CS)
- Assign trace windows (CS + Ops)
- VPC pre-provisioning (Eng/Infra)
- Day7 survey + Day14 interview (Enablement)
- Mark renewal risks + mitigation (CS)

jo_cs: I'll compile and post the sanitized kickoff notes after the meeting. If you own an action, update the sheet row as you complete it.
